rationale: This mutation resolves the $9,500 cash gap by synchronizing workforce and contiguous land scaling to 28-32 plots with 10-11 hands through Day 15, while elevating Oracle Frontrun ahead of routine liquidation to dump vulnerable commodities at >=0.80x base before opponent dumps collapse market prices. It captures massive town shop premiums by prioritizing immediate shed arbitrage, dynamically allocating 3-4 plots for >=2.2x Carrot contracts, and activating a Days 22-26 hyper-fertilized Carrot backfill to monetize idle endgame acreage. Finally, farm micro-dispatch eliminates dry-interval regrowth halts via pre-harvest well refills for zero-delay in-situ watering and enforces backpack-gated shed drop-offs (>=75% capacity) alongside dynamic midday liquidations (>=0.78x floor) and step 696 terminal clearance.
